verdict.rationale: The SDK supports composing multi-agent work via subagents (parallel isolated instances), agent teams (coordinated instances with a lead), and a mention of 'dynamic workflows' as one of five task-composition patterns, plus hooks that can gate/branch tool execution. However, there is no documented explicit graph/workflow API (e.g., a DAG builder, loop constructs, conditional branching primitives) — orchestration is largely implicit, driven by the agent loop and natural-language delegation rather than a declarative workflow graph. Missing for 10: explicit graph/workflow-definition API, first-class loop constructs, first-class branching/conditional routing between agents, and independent corroboration of building complex workflows this way.
